{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent estimand description for PRO: 'Week 12' vs 'Week 14'",
      "quote": "Change from baseline to Week 14 in PRO endpoints between AMG 510 and docetaxel",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The PRO secondary estimand description states 'Week 14' while the endpoint definition and other text consistently refer to 'week 12' (e.g., 'Change from baseline (cycle 1 day 1) over time to week 12'). This discrepancy could lead to incorrect analysis and interpretation.",
      "fix": "Correct the estimand description to 'Week 12' to match the endpoint definition and other protocol text."
    },
    {
      "title": "Cross-reference to non-existent sections",
      "quote": "See Section 99.1.6 and Section 8.1.7 for AMG 510 and docetaxel treatment beyond radiologic progression.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol references 'Section 99.1.6' which is not a valid section number (likely a placeholder or typo). Also, Section 8.1.7 is not defined in the provided text. This makes it impossible for readers to locate the referenced information.",
      "fix": "Replace 'Section 99.1.6' with the correct section number and ensure Section 8.1.7 exists and is correctly referenced."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of 'treatment period' and 'safety follow-up'",
      "quote": "The study will consist of a screening period, a treatment period, a safety follow-up (SFU) period, and long-term follow-up period.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The synopsis lists four periods but does not define the duration or content of the safety follow-up (SFU) period. The Schedule of Activities (Section 1.3) is referenced but not provided, so the SFU period's assessments and duration are unclear.",
      "fix": "Add a brief description of the SFU period (e.g., duration, key assessments) in the synopsis or ensure the Schedule of Activities clearly defines it."
    },
    {
      "title": "Unclear timing of crossover for docetaxel arm",
      "quote": "Once subjects on the docetaxel arm are determined to have radiological progression according to RECIST v1.1 by the investigator and progressive disease undergoes independent central confirmation, they will be given the opportunity to crossover and receive AMG 510.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The text does not specify the time window between investigator-assessed progression and central confirmation, nor whether crossover is allowed before central confirmation. This ambiguity could lead to inconsistent implementation across sites.",
      "fix": "Specify the required timing for central confirmation and clarify that crossover occurs only after central confirmation, or define an alternative process."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing definition of 'treatment beyond progression' criteria",
      "quote": "Subjects that undergo treatment beyond progression or crossover, from docetaxel to AMG 510, will continue to receive scans after confirmation of first PD.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions 'treatment beyond progression' but does not define the criteria for allowing it (e.g., clinical benefit, tolerability). This is a critical operational detail that could affect subject safety and data interpretation.",
      "fix": "Add a section defining the conditions under which treatment beyond progression is permitted, including required assessments and stopping rules."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent use of 'BICR' vs 'independent central confirmation'",
      "quote": "Tumor assessment and response will be confirmed by BICR who will evaluate disease progressions and responses without the knowledge of randomization assignments",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol uses both 'BICR' and 'independent central confirmation' (e.g., 'independent central confirmation of progression') without clarifying whether they are the same or different. This could cause confusion in implementation.",
      "fix": "Define both terms and use them consistently, or use a single term throughout."
    },
    {
      "title": "Missing details on stratification factor 'history of CNS involvement'",
      "quote": "Subjects will be stratified by number of prior lines of therapy in advanced disease (1 versus 2 versus > 2), race (Asian versus non-Asian), and history of central nervous system (CNS) involvement (present or absent).",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define what constitutes 'history of CNS involvement' (e.g., treated vs untreated, stable vs progressive). This ambiguity could lead to misclassification and imbalance in stratification.",
      "fix": "Provide a clear definition of 'history of CNS involvement' in the inclusion/exclusion criteria or a separate section."
    },
    {
      "title": "Unclear timing of 'pre-specified OS events'",
      "quote": "All subjects remaining on study will be followed for survival, as specified in the Schedule of Activities (Section 1.3), until the pre-specified OS events are reached, regardless of the OS analysis result at the PFS primary analysis.",
      "page": 10,
      "section": "1.1 Synopsis",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not specify the number of OS events required for the final OS analysis. This is a critical design element for sample size and study duration, and its absence could lead to operational uncertainty.",
      "fix": "State the target number of OS events (e.g., 'approximately 200 OS events') in the synopsis or statistical analysis section."
    }
  ]
}
